title: Source Navigation
learnerPromise: I can tell what kind of Jewish source I am looking at and how to orient inside it.

title: Hebrew & Text Signals
learnerPromise: I can notice Hebrew anchors, repeated words, and structure cues that make a text readable.

title: Torah / Tanakh Literacy
learnerPromise: I can read biblical passages for scene, command, narrative, repetition, and interpretation.

title: Mishnah Literacy
learnerPromise: I can identify case, ruling, dispute, category, and boundary in a Mishnah.

title: Gemara Moves
learnerPromise: I can follow questions, answers, challenges, proofs, distinctions, rejections, and conclusions.

title: Halakha Reasoning
learnerPromise: I can distinguish source, ruling, custom, application, and responsible practical boundaries.

title: Midrash & Aggadah
learnerPromise: I can see how rabbinic texts interpret verses, tell stories, and form meaning.

title: Jewish Thought
learnerPromise: I can follow claims, questions, arguments, metaphors, and spiritual or ethical implications.

title: Tefillah / Siddur Literacy
learnerPromise: I can orient in prayer and recognize blessing structure, prayer moves, and source echoes.

title: Jewish History & Canon Formation
learnerPromise: I can place texts and figures in broad historical context without reducing Torah to history.

title: Jewish Life & Practice
learnerPromise: I can recognize Jewish practice categories and ask better questions in Jewish spaces.

title: Study Habits & Metacognition
learnerPromise: I can build rhythm, recover after gaps, use feedback, and see progress as growing capability.
